title: HeyHi Design Bridge Scene-Graph IR
description: Intermediate representation produced by the Translate extractor and consumed by the use_figma Builder. One IR per breakpoint. The IR is the reviewed contract between reading the source and writing the artifact: it is validated and diffed without opening Figma, and it is the artifact the human reviewer approves before any canvas write. v0.2 (ADR-010) is additive over v0.1: it adds cornerRadius, strokes, effects, and opacity node fields so corner-radius, box-shadow, borders, and opacity have a node slot instead of being flagged as schema gaps. All four are optional; v0.1 IRs remain structurally valid under v0.2. v0.3 (ADR-013) is additive over v0.2: it makes IMAGE a first-class fill type (imageRef/scaleMode/imagePosition on the fill, retiring P2's kind:"IMAGE" stopgap) and adds the optional node fields position{x,y} (a child's offset inside a NONE-layout frame) and runs[] (inline styled text ranges). All new fields are optional; a v0.2 IR is valid under v0.3 once its $schema const is bumped. v0.4 (ADR-014) is additive over v0.3: it adds optional layoutWrap, counterAxisSpacing, and counterAxisAlignContent to the layout object so a wrapping flex line and a multi-row CSS grid map to a Figma layoutWrap:WRAP auto-layout instead of a flagged single-line approximation. All new fields are optional; a v0.3 IR is valid under v0.4 once its $schema const is bumped.

source.description: Path to the source HTML prototype.

breakpoint.description: Which breakpoint this IR was extracted at.

generated_by.description: Tool + version that emitted this IR.

tokens_used.description: Every CSS-custom-property to design-token resolution made during extraction, with its provenance.

resolved.description: Computed literal carried for the preview and as a hardcoded fallback.

source.description: declared = bare var() in the stylesheet (a lookup); computed = read from getComputedStyle; matched = nearest-token confidence match.

mode.description: NONE means absolute positioning; flag it for human review.

layoutWrap.description: Figma layoutWrap. Valid only when mode==='HORIZONTAL'. WRAP lets a horizontal auto-layout flow onto multiple rows: the Figma model for a wrapping flex line and a multi-row CSS grid. (ADR-014)

counterAxisSpacing.description: WRAP only: vertical gap between wrapped rows (CSS row-gap). Maps to Figma counterAxisSpacing; the extractor emits an explicit number (Figma treats null as sync-to-itemSpacing). (ADR-014)

counterAxisAlignContent.description: WRAP only: distribution of wrapped rows along the counter axis (CSS align-content space-* -> SPACE_BETWEEN, else AUTO). (ADR-014)

fill.description: A bind (token path) is what gets written as a Figma Variable binding; resolved is the literal fallback. Color binds; typography never does (see node.type_style). A GRADIENT_* fill additionally carries stops[] and (linear) angle on additionalProperties. An IMAGE fill (ADR-013) carries imageRef + scaleMode (+ optional imagePosition focal point); the figma.createImage embed is the gated live step.

imageRef.description: IMAGE fill only: path to the raster to embed via figma.createImage.

scaleMode.description: IMAGE fill only: Figma ImagePaint scaleMode (background-size cover->FILL, contain->FIT).

imagePosition.description: IMAGE fill only: normalized 0..1 focal point (background-position intent).

typeStyle.description: Typography fields are SET DIRECTLY on the text node; Figma does not bind them to Variables. token_ref records the source token for traceability only.

flag.description: A does-not-map-cleanly feature, surfaced and never silently dropped.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius, set directly on the node (a float; not Variable-bound in v0.2, consistent with itemSpacing/padding). A single number is a uniform radius; the object form carries mixed corners. (ADR-010)

stroke.description: A border mapped to a Figma stroke. weight is a float set directly; color binds like a fill (a declared var() becomes a Variable binding). (ADR-010)

effect.description: A box-shadow mapped to a Figma effect. Figma nodes carry multiple effects, so stacked CSS shadows map to multiple effect entries rather than being flagged. Shadow color is carried as a resolved literal (it usually carries alpha and rarely maps to a brand token). (ADR-010)

position.description: A node's offset from its parent frame's top-left, used when the parent is a NONE-layout (absolute) container; the Builder sets node.x/node.y. (ADR-013)

runStyle.description: Per-range typography for an inline run (ADR-013): a partial type style plus italic. Applied via setRangeFontName / setRange* in the Builder.

run.description: An inline styled text range over a TEXT node's characters (ADR-013): a <span class=accent> colour run or an <em>/<strong> style run. start/end are character offsets (end exclusive) over the post-newline characters. fill is applied via setRangeFills; style via setRangeFontName / setRange*.

svgRef.description: VECTOR only: path to the SVG to import via createNodeFromSvg.

imageRef.description: IMAGE only: path to the raster to place.

opacity.description: Node opacity when below 1, set directly. (ADR-010)

runs.description: TEXT only: inline styled ranges over characters, applied via setRange* in the Builder. (ADR-013)
